name: model-selector
description: Compact current-model control that opens an adaptive searchable, provider-grouped sheet and commits one model.
avoidWhen: Do not use for settings preferences, multi-select filters, or loading a remote catalog; use preference-picker or chip and keep data fetching in the app.

ux.behaviour: The 48 dp trigger always names the selected model and exposes expanded or collapsed state to TalkBack
ux.why: The model answering next never feels hidden

ux.behaviour: The whole trigger scales under press and fires a click haptic
ux.why: The compact control still feels like a full touch target
ux.reducedMotion: No scale; ripple, state description, and haptic remain

ux.behaviour: Catalogs through seven models open thumb-first without search; catalogs from eight show Search and filter model and provider names live
ux.why: A short choice should not pay a keyboard tax, while a long choice should be ready for the first letter

ux.behaviour: A query with no matches keeps Search, shows one polite live-region message, and leaves Clear available
ux.why: A miss is easy to revise and never masquerades as an empty catalog

ux.behaviour: A changed row ticks, emits its stable id once, and closes; the current row closes without emitting
ux.why: One tap finishes the choice without producing duplicate state work

ux.behaviour: Selection, back, drag, and scrim all clear the query and hide the IME before the sheet leaves
ux.why: The next visit starts with the complete catalog

aiHints: Keep selectedId in caller-owned saveable state and ensure it matches exactly one supplied model
Use stable model and provider ids; never use a changeable display name as an id
Write a short behavioral capability for every model instead of marketing copy
Pass models in product-priority order; the component groups without alphabetizing
Filter unavailable models before calling this component and keep loading, networking, and entitlement policy outside it
Use only local ImageVector provider marks and do not fetch logos
Do not add external expanded or query state, another dialog, or a dropdown around this component
